obstruction_classes.description: A counterfactual payoff/debt atom is not yet a source-matched strategic gain.
A reached-row gain is not yet compiled through an exact cap/state return.

transitions.summary: Every finite quitting game whose corrected normal core has cardinality three has an ordinary uniform-equilibrium payoff. Hence a four-player counterexample must have full corrected core, and both remaining leaves may be studied under that table-level restriction.

The global-debt barrier certificate needs only the Never boundary and invariance under every one-row prefix; all other elementary boundaries and all finite elementary words are generated from these data.

Mechanically exhaustive antichain: every counterexample regime and every starting-profile sequence produce a bounded pure-time reset sequence ending in either an observer-absent forced-owner wall or an observer-containing reached-row gain.
An observer-containing singleton terminal is already handled by the cardinality-free actual-row localization, so manuscript Alternative 3 and GitHub issue #5 require no independent branch.

Iterating exact pure-time self-resets for at most card(I)+1 steps forces a fixed positive-mass terminal. Membership of the final reset player in that terminal gives exactly the two remaining branches. The prescribed-comparison and negative-target branches are therefore unnecessary, closing manuscript Alternatives 1 and 4 and GitHub issues #3 and #6.

The observer-absent endpoint retains one fixed terminal, observer, owner, and finite clock along a strict subsequence. Every selected row has an exact forced-owner profile, a uniform cylinder-mass floor, the terminal-gap barrier, and the coordinate-defect/refusal alternative.

The observer-containing endpoint retains a fixed non-observer and a strict subsequence whose actual-row best-endpoint gain has an explicit positive lower bound. No terminal-cardinality, reward-sign, or external nonemptiness hypothesis is required.

A concrete positive global terminal-debt floor does not require a uniform finite-horizon cutoff: the semantic carrier is exactly the closure of finite prefix evaluations from the elementary boundaries, and any inductive finite-dimensional barrier containing those boundaries proves a fixed terminal exploitability gap and nonexistence.

Any axis-aligned or coordinatewise order-compatible semantic barrier containing the required elementary boundary pairs also contains a zero-total-debt diagonal. A successful barrier must couple player coordinates.
No positive global-debt certificate can use a barrier whose membership depends only on envelope minus prescribed payoff. A successful barrier must retain absolute semantic level.
Canonical punishment-floor prefix-capacity finiteness is derived from the positive terminal exploitability gap rather than stored in the counterexample regime.
